government_dmv_context.statement: Under NRS 116.3102 a Nevada community association may cause a vehicle to be removed when it is improperly parked on property owned or leased by the association, or on a road, street, alley or other thoroughfare within the community. 48 hours' notice is required except for fire hydrants, fire lanes, accessible spaces, or an imminent threat to health, safety or welfare.
government_dmv_context.why_it_matters: Sets the boundary of what an association can actually do. A vehicle on the owner's own driveway is outside this power, which is the opposite of what the live page implies.
